label: Fires on reaching S2 at D2, stronger after an unrewarded S2 visit or S1-favoring belief.
terms: (phase == D2) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) * (ep_trial < 3)
explanation: Sparse feature (3% of steps), silent at D1 and GO; active only at D2 when the reached state is S2 (observed at D2). Magnitude rises when the previous trial also reached S2 and was unrewarded, and with the observer belief that S1 is good (i.e. arriving at the believed-bad state); it is lower after a rewarded previous trial. The free fit adds the choice (a2, common arrival), an unrewarded S2 two trials back, and an early-episode boost (beyond the timing baseline), reaching about 0.30 dev vs 0.285 for the short form. Activations are spiky (often near 1 on single steps), so much variance stays unexplained; observed-only additive ceiling in the profile was 0.24.
